objective: Explore a fictional miniature village with inspectable architecture, authored creature locomotion, connected mill and door mechanics, persistent water, and one isolated delivery-cargo contact experiment.
custom_choices: Terraced fantasy settlement with distinct architecture and mythical species
Persistent pond and stream share one authored water level while flow changes only surface cues and mill response
Detailed delivery cargo uses one enclosing collider in a reserved yard
Buildings, props and planting assembled from the shipped kit blueprints (examples/early-slice/kits), with authored geometry only where no blueprint fits

runtime.render_scheduling: Demand-driven RAF, max60fps, hidden suspension, paused camera/input invalidation;1024px directional shadow map.
runtime.postprocessing: postprocessing@6.39.4 (pmndrs); BloomEffect + VignetteEffect + ToneMappingEffect in one EffectPass

tone_mapping.applied_by: postprocessing ToneMappingEffect (renderer.toneMapping = NoToneMapping while the stack is alive)

looks.switch: ?look=<style-id> / ?mood=<lighting-mood-id>; unknown ids warn and fall back
looks.table: village-look-table.js - every entry names its record and its departures
looks.scope: sky, fog, environment, lights, tone mapping, post, and the lens for tilt-shift only; no geometry and no material
looks.note: every value above in sky/fog/environment/post/tone_mapping is the default look; the others are in the table

runtime.viewer_contract: window.__sceneReady after the first composer.render; window.__viewer = {views, setView(name)->boolean, stats(), tiers(), pinLevel(index|null)}; window.__renderStats() reports renderer.info for the whole composited frame. ?level=N pins every landmark LOD to one level (debug only).

draw_calls_measured.note: 1280x720 headless Chromium on the GPU (ANGLE Metal, Apple M4 Max), 1.4 s settle so the 0.9 s focus tween has finished; includes the shadow pass and the post passes, renderer.info.autoReset = false. The same build measured on the same host before the tier work read 2902 / 1955 / 2060: the overview and fox savings are the watermill's 287-mesh assembly collapsing to one baked mesh past 9.49 m, and the mill close view is unchanged because T2 adds no draw call. Revision 8's published numbers were SwiftShader and are not like-for-like.

runtime.instancing: 6 InstancedMesh fields the scene drives itself over 466 decorative instances (52 shore boulders on nature/rock-cluster's shape, 224 path pavers, 68 reed blades on nature/reeds' blade, 24 grass blades, 49 flower stems, 49 petals), plus 70 InstancedMesh inside the blueprints over about 1236 instances (tile courses, fence rails, staves, planks, canopies). One material cache, in kits/kit-core.js; scene-kit.js is an adapter over it.

kits.source: examples/early-slice/kits/** - 36 module files, byte-identical copies of skills/3dviz-pro-max/templates/kits/** (the skill also holds a README, a proof harness and a Blender script, which are not copied)
creatures: quadruped-walker (moon deer mesh only; village-locomotion.js remains the gait authority)
kits.layout: village-layout.nearestPathPoint only. planVillage was not used: its plots would move the landmarks that the picking tests, the focus presets and the capture views name.
authored_here: inn hinged door leaf and pivot
mill sluice gate and axle drive key
Morel Cottage stalk, cap, gills and spots
glasshouse panes, frame bars and herb beds
path ribbons, pavers and flower drifts
three-tail fox, jade dragon, lavender owl
kits.one_driver_rule: The watermill blueprint's animate(dt) is never called. The hub found at its `wheel` socket is re-hung under the scene's own pivot and turned by the flow control.

T3.asset: kits/gltf/watermill-t3.glb (1,915,772 bytes, 12,598 triangles, one mesh, one material)
T3.why_not_nearest: the bake is frozen; the wheel, axle and sluice are this scene's one mechanism, so the procedural build draws inside 9.49 m

T2.departs_from_proof: proofs use size 1024 and 13 AO samples; this village builds fourteen objects at page load
T2.families: village-tier-families.js - copied from tiers.T2.families where a record declares it, read off the module PALETTE where it does not

unmapped_colours.note: glass, foliage, water, fruit and flames are unmapped on purpose; the watermill's own T2 proof log lists the same 37-colour jittered set

T1.note: instanced fields are one draw call each and are never wrapped in a LOD; a host with no 2D canvas builds the whole village at T1

objects: one blockout per landmark, sized from what was built
T0.note: clamped past the 40 m OrbitControls ceiling so a grey box never lands in a shipped frame; visible only under ?level=N; not pickable

lod.distance_rule: fit = 2.92 x bounding-sphere radius; close 0.78 x fit, mid 1.2 x fit, far 2.4 x fit - the proof logs' own ratios, re-derived from what was built because every kit here is scaled to doll size
lod.demand_loop: village-scene.updateLevels(camera) runs before each render; autoUpdate stays true as a safety net

frame_time_ms.note: vsync-bound at 120 Hz on this host before and after; no frame-rate claim is made.

page_to_first_frame_ms.note: T2 draws its maps and bakes vertex occlusion at page load; 1.70 s of the T2 figure is the bake.

scenes.motion: fixed-step acceleration-limited controlled locomotion with swept environment contacts
entities: flat bridge deck with sloped approaches
actions: click a building or creature on the canvas to select and focus it
boundaries: Fictional miniature; no agent scheduling, biology or ecology claim. Authored creature and mill controllers; isolated cargo uses real rigid-body dynamics.

physical_contract.scope: Illustrative units; controlled creatures plus isolated Rapier cargo. No aerodynamic or fluid solver.
physical_contract.colliders: Blueprint collider descriptors for the three kit-built landmarks and for every kit prop and tree; geometry-derived world AABBs for the authored inn and cottage; animated yaw-enclosing creature envelopes. 164 world boxes, down from 210, because a blueprint declares fewer and coarser solids than its meshes occupy.
physical_contract.time: Creature fixed step 1/90s with .25s cap; cargo fixed step 1/60s with .1s cap. Global pause passes zero delta.
physical_contract.support: Support-aware navigation and candidate movement with explicit foot search radius, step/slope constraints. Flat road ribbons and bridge approaches. Full bridge traversal is not exposed or certified. A 200-sample groundHeight/supportAt harness over the island returned 0/200 differences across the kit rebuild.
physical_contract.contact: Swept environment contact removes inward velocity; navigation uses the same expanded volumes
limits: Actor-to-actor separation is authored; no dynamic actor collision or current pairwise replay guarantee.
Future routes across abrupt terrace changes require swept support transitions
Plants and decorative motes are non-solid
Conservative bounds may block visually open space
physical_contract.cargo: One rigid cuboid with CCD, gravity, friction, finite retaining walls; off-center impulse only when settled. Quaternion-aware underside clearance. Reserved from creature navigation.
physical_contract.water: Persistent pond and flat stream at y=.1675; authored flow changes surface cues only. Water geometry and support identity remain fixed across flow/pause/reset.
physical_contract.water_texture: Shared128x128 color and normal textures, generated once;world-XZ UVs;periodic offsets follow authored flow. No extra reflection/refraction scene pass.

selection_scope: Current Latent Village example only; selected records guide the bounded village refinement and do not claim that every catalog record was fully implemented.
